task_completion.description: Set the location to New York City (40.71° N, 74.00° W).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Location window or the status bar at the bottom of the Stellarium screen shows 'New York, United States' or the specific coordinates 40°42'N, 74°00'W.

task_completion.description: Set the date and time to March 14, 2025, at 06:58 UTC.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Date/Time window or the status bar shows '2025-03-14 06:58:00' (or the equivalent local time if UTC is not explicitly toggled, usually UTC-4 or UTC-5 for NYC).

task_completion.description: Enable Azimuthal Grid, Constellation Lines, and Cardinal Points; disable Atmosphere.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The bottom toolbar shows the Azimuthal Grid [Z], Constellation Lines [C], and Cardinal Points [Q] icons highlighted/active. The Atmosphere [A] icon is inactive. The sky view shows grid lines and constellation outlines without atmospheric haze.

task_completion.description: Target and center the Moon during the total lunar eclipse.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Moon is centered in the view with a selection pointer/crosshair. The Moon should appear reddish/dark (totality) and the info text in the top left confirms 'Moon' is selected.

task_completion.description: Save a screenshot to the specified directory and ensure settings are saved.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A notification or file explorer view showing a new image file in '~/Pictures/stellarium/' or the agent clicking 'Save settings' in the Configuration window.

task_completion.description: Create the text file ~/Desktop/eclipse_event_guide.txt with required content.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like Gedit or Mousepad) or a terminal 'cat' command showing the file at ~/Desktop/eclipse_event_guide.txt containing 'New York City', '2025-03-14', and 'Total Lunar Eclipse / Moon'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Stellarium GUI to configure settings rather than just editing config files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Stellarium menus (Location, Date/Time, Search) and the bottom toolbar icons.

integrity.description: The visual state of the Moon matches the specific eclipse timing.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Moon in the screenshot appears in the Earth's shadow (reddish hue) rather than a standard full moon or a black screen.

integrity.description: The agent manually typed or navigated to the coordinates and time.
integrity.visual_evidence: Intermediate screenshots show the input fields in the Location and Date/Time dialogs being populated.
